features.name: log_income_scaled
features.description: Borrower income log-scaled with training-fold minimum and maximum, then clipped for outlier control.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supports a near-linear income capacity effect after reducing skew and extreme income leverage.

features.name: loan_income_burden_scaled
features.description: Loan size as a share of income, normalized by the maximum observed training-fold share.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a smooth affordability severity axis useful for linear margin placement.

features.name: interest_rate_scaled
features.description: Interest rate normalized from the training-fold minimum and maximum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures pricing intensity as a smooth numeric dimension with comparable scale to other features.

features.name: interest_income_pressure_scaled
features.description: Approximate annual interest cost divided by income, scaled by a high training-fold burden reference.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a rate-by-size interaction as one continuous pressure measure that a linear model could not form from raw fields alone.

features.name: credit_score_scaled
features.description: Credit score normalized from the training-fold minimum and maximum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a compact credit quality axis with a stable numeric scale.

features.name: credit_history_age_share
features.description: Credit history length divided by plausible adult financial years.
features.expected_model_benefit: Represents maturity of the credit file relative to age, smoothing an important cross-field relation.

features.name: employment_age_share
features.description: Employment experience divided by plausible adult working years.
features.expected_model_benefit: Represents work-experience maturity relative to age, aiding stable linear separation.

features.name: prior_default_indicator
features.description: Binary marker for recorded previous loan defaults in the borrower file.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives direct access to historical repayment friction in a one-dimensional indicator.

features.name: housing_stability_score
features.description: Ordinal residential stability score derived from home ownership category.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts home-ownership categories into an ordered stability dimension instead of relying only on sparse binary expansions.

features.name: education_attainment_score
features.description: Ordinal attainment score derived from education category.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts education categories into an ordered human-capital dimension with a monotone scale.

features.name: purpose_economic_constructiveness_score
features.description: Semantic score from 0.0 to 1.0 using loan_intent and row context. Higher values indicate the stated use plausibly preserves or improves earning capacity, health or education continuity, or productive assets; lower values indicate more discretionary or weakly income-linked use.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an ordered purpose axis so the margin can use semantic differences among intended uses without sparse intent indicators.

features.name: profile_plausibility_score
features.description: Semantic consistency score from 0.0 to 1.0 using age, employment experience, credit-history length, income, loan amount, and rate. Higher values indicate an internally coherent ordinary financial profile; lower values indicate unusual or internally inconsistent combinations such as very high age, experience exceeding plausible working years, or income and loan scale mismatch.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes row coherence and outlier severity in one smooth score, helping reduce influence from rare extreme combinations.
